scenes.title: TODAY IS FRIDAY THE 13TH
scenes.sub: And it's the third one this year

scenes.title: THE RULE
scenes.sub: Any month that starts on a Sunday always has a Friday the 13th

scenes.title: IT'S NOT RARE
scenes.sub: Over the 400-year calendar cycle, the 13th falls on a Friday more than any other day
